main.description: Notify that a space repo has been updated. Sent by repo hosts to the space host, which forwards it to registered syncing services. Requires service auth.

spaceRev.description: Set by the space host on notifications forwarded to syncing services.

prevSpaceRev.description: Omitted on the first update in a space. A gap indicates missed notifications, which can be recovered with listRepos.

errors.name: FutureRev
errors.description: The repo revision is too far in the future.
